question: In which of the following places was the first edition of the World Para Table Tennis Championships held in 1990?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assen, Netherlands.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Para Table Tennis Championship, which started in** 1990 in Assen, Netherlands,** has been held formerly **every four times** featuring both platoon and individual events, with its last edition in Beijing, China in 2014.
 
• The event has ago been restructured to point to platoon events at odd times, and individual events at indeed times.
 
• The **2018 World Para Table Tennis Crowns will be the first World title event for individual para table tennis events after the Rio 2016 Paralympic Games and will see an estimated 330 of the World’s stylish para table tennis players swarming to Slovenia to contend for the World Crowns titles in 21 order** events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **2022 edition:**

 
 
• The **Andalucia 2022 World Para Table Tennis Crowns started in style on Sunday 6 November in the southern Spanish megacity of Granada.**
 
• After an inspiring opening form showcasing the athletes to a flamenco meter, seven days of amazing action began.
 
• An aggregate of **39 World titles is at stake, in 11 classes for men and women.**
 
• For the first time ever, titles will be awarded for women in class 1 and mixed doubles, further perfecting gender equivalency in Para table tennis.
